using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying.CSharp;
using Volo.Abp.Http.Modeling;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying.Tests;

public class CSharpServiceProxyGeneratorTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly CSharpServiceProxyGenerator _generator;

    public CSharpServiceProxyGeneratorTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>>();
        _mockLogger.Setup(x => x.Log(
            It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Information),
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Create")),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));

        // Create generator with mocked dependencies
        _generator = new CSharpServiceProxyGenerator(
            Mock.Of<CliHttpClientFactory>(),
            Mock.Of<IJsonSerializer>());
        
        // Inject logger using reflection since it's not constructor-injected
        typeof(CSharpServiceProxyGenerator).GetField("Logger", 
            System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?
            .SetValue(_generator, _mockLogger.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GenerateProxyAsync_Should_LogInformation_For_Interface_File_Creation()
    {
        // Arrange
        var args = new GenerateProxyArgs
        {
            WorkDirectory = "/tmp/test",
            Folder = "ClientProxies",
            WithoutContracts = false // Ensure contracts are generated
        };

        // Mock minimal API model to trigger interface generation path
        var mockApiModel = new ApplicationApiDescriptionModel
        {
            Modules = new Dictionary<string, ModuleApiDescriptionModel>
            {
                ["TestModule"] = new ModuleApiDescriptionModel
                {
                    Controllers = new Dictionary<string, ControllerApiDescriptionModel>
                    {
                        ["TestController"] = new ControllerApiDescriptionModel
                        {
                            Interfaces = new List<InterfaceApiDescriptionModel>
                            {
                                new InterfaceApiDescriptionModel
                                {
                                    Type = "TestAppService",
                                    Methods = new List<ActionApiDescriptionModel>()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        // Setup base class to return mock API model
        var baseField = typeof(CSharpServiceProxyGenerator).BaseType?
            .GetField("_applicationApiDescriptionModel", 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
        baseField?.SetValue(_generator, mockApiModel);

        // Act
        await _generator.GenerateProxyAsync(args);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(x => x.Log(
            It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Information),
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Create ") && 
                                        v.ToString()!.Contains(".cs")),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.AtLeastOnce());
    }
}
